request: Pull US federal candidate (House/Senate/President) fundraising totals for the 2024 cycle from the FEC's api.open.fec.gov /v1/candidates/totals endpoint. ~5,323 candidates. One row per candidate-cycle. Enrich with receipts_band (numeric_bin on receipts: micro <10k / small <100k / mid <1M / large <5M / mega >=5M) and party_class (map_values on party: DEM=democratic, REP=republican, LIB=libertarian, GRE=green, IND=independent, others=other). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 27 - FEC Candidate Totals' on Tableau Server for state boards of elections and civic-transparency organizations. Uses DEMO_KEY or user-supplied API_DATA_GOV_KEY.

sources.name: FEC Candidate Totals (2024 cycle)
sources.description: US Federal Election Commission candidate fundraising totals for the 2024 election cycle. One row per candidate-cycle. Fields: candidate_id, name, office (H=House/S=Senate/P=President), office_full, state, state_full, district, party, party_class, incumbent_challenge (I/C/O), incumbent_challenge_full, cycle, cash_on_hand_end_period, receipts, receipts_band (micro <10k / small <100k / mid <1M / large <5M / mega >=5M), disbursements, individual_itemized_contributions, other_political_committee_contributions, transfers_from_other_authorized_committee, debts_owed_by_committee, coverage_start_date, coverage_end_date, has_raised_funds. Pulled via page-based pagination (per_page=100) with a soft cap of ~5,500 rows.

args.name: FEC Candidate Totals Trend
args.features_description: Row-level FEC 2024-cycle candidate totals (~5,323 candidates). Fields: candidate_id, name, office, office_full, state, district, party, party_class, incumbent_challenge, cycle, cash_on_hand_end_period, receipts, receipts_band, disbursements, individual_itemized_contributions, other_political_committee_contributions, transfers_from_other_authorized_committee, debts_owed_by_committee, coverage_start_date, coverage_end_date, has_raised_funds, candidate_inactive.
args.stats_description: Long-form FEC statistics (one row per dimension x value over state, party_class, office, receipts_band). Includes counts, z-score anomalies vs national baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify state-level outliers in candidate fundraising and party competitiveness.

outputs.name: FEC Candidate Totals
outputs.description: Row-level FEC 2024-cycle candidate fundraising totals (~5,323 candidates). Fields: candidate_id, name, office (H/S/P), office_full, state, state_full, district, party, party_class (democratic/republican/libertarian/green/independent/others), party_full, incumbent_challenge (I=incumbent/C=challenger/O=open), incumbent_challenge_full, cycle, cash_on_hand_end_period, receipts, receipts_band (micro <10k / small <100k / mid <1M / large <5M / mega >=5M), disbursements, individual_itemized_contributions, other_political_committee_contributions, transfers_from_other_authorized_committee, debts_owed_by_committee, coverage_start_date, coverage_end_date, has_raised_funds, candidate_inactive. Source: api.open.fec.gov /v1/candidates/totals?election_year=2024. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: FEC Candidate Totals Stats
outputs.description: Long-form FEC statistics (one row per dimension x value over state, party_class, office, receipts_band). Includes counts, z-score anomalies vs national baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value). Use to identify state-level outliers in candidate fundraising and party competitiveness.
